request: User Login (CU-AUTH-02 / HU-02): Add POST /api/identity/auth/login. Normalize email (trim + lowercase) and verify password. On valid credentials return 200 with accessToken (15m TTL, sub=userId, role claim) and rotating refreshToken (7d TTL, persisted with unique jti). On invalid email or password return 401 with generic code INVALID_CREDENTIALS without leaking account existence. Enforce rate limit of 10 attempts/min/IP returning 429.
expectations: token refresh endpoint and client-side token storage are out of scope
context: area: internal/adapter/http (chi router, error envelope, visitor limiter)
constraint: internal/domain imports only the standard library

FR-001.title: Normalize the email before verifying credentials

FR-002.title: Return access and refresh tokens on valid credentials
FR-002.assumes: Rotation is delivered by the next slice; this spec issues a unique persisted refresh token.

FR-003.title: Return generic INVALID_CREDENTIALS without leaking account existence

FR-004.title: Rate limit sign-in attempts to 10 per minute per IP

intent: Add POST /api/identity/auth/login returning access and refresh tokens with email normalization, generic credential errors, and a per-IP rate limit.

decisions.decision: Sign access tokens with github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5 using HMAC-SHA256 and a symmetric JWT_SECRET.
decisions.why: The constitution mandates jwt/v5 for short-lived tokens; one service issues its own tokens, so a symmetric secret is the smallest sound choice.

decisions.decision: Persist refresh tokens in a new refresh_tokens table keyed by unique jti, with token hash, user id, expiry, and revocation state; rotation revokes the presented token.
decisions.why: Rotation requires per-token lookup and revocation; unique jti is the rotation key.

decisions.decision: Reuse the per-visitor limiter with a policy constructor; login allows 10 attempts per 60s window and returns 429 with the existing rate_limited code.
Reuse the centralized error envelope codes invalid_credentials and rate_limited.
decisions.why: One envelope and one code per outcome.

decisions.decision: Login rate limiting uses github.com/go-chi/httprate with an explicit peer-address key, replacing NewLoginAttemptLimiter on VisitorLimiter.
decisions.why: httprate is the constitution-approved rate limit component, was unused, and the reviewer chose it. Keying on the peer address keeps the documented trust model: forwarding headers are not trusted.
decisions.rejected: Keep the hand-rolled VisitorLimiter login policy

decisions.decision: The refresh_tokens table keeps jti as the primary key and revoked_at as a timestamp.
decisions.why: jti is already unique and is the rotation key, so a separate id adds a column nothing reads; a timestamp records when revocation happened.
decisions.rejected: Add an id primary key plus a boolean revoked column

decisions.decision: Converge appended T017-T023 rather than reporting a clean pass.
decisions.why: An unregistered email returns 404 today, which leaks account existence and contradicts FR-003; four verification gaps and two leftovers were also found.

decisions.decision: Refresh token rotation is out of scope for this spec; it moves to the next slice.
decisions.why: The spec Assumptions place token storage between access and refresh out of scope, and the developer scoped rotation to the auth middleware slice.
decisions.rejected: Append rotation as T024 and keep this spec open
